reserves.name: GHO deposited in Aave Savings module

reserveReview.rationale: The current sGHO implementation and asset() at Ethereum block 26095797 identify GHO as the sole ERC-4626 accounting asset. Deposited GHO remains in the vault; yield is funded separately by the DAO.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Aave sGHO product documentation and asset() at Ethereum block 26095797 on 2026-10-01
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: No material unclassified reserve exposure is present; sGHO inherits GHO protocol and facilitator risk.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: GHO is held on-chain in the savings vault and is not rehypothecated. This does not establish legal segregation or bankruptcy remoteness, and the governance-controlled proxy and pause roles remain applicable.
